skill_name: Describe the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on the fashion industry.
workflow: The COVID-19 pandemic has had a devastating effect on the fashion industry as global supply chains and demand have been disrupted. Many retailers have closed their stores and resorted to selling their products online, making it difficult for buyers to get a sense of the product.
